AI_MANAGER.TITLE: Manager
AI_MANAGER.SUBTITLE: The Manager reads your agent's conversations, finds what went wrong and brings the fix ready with the evidence attached, for you to approve or dismiss.
AI_MANAGER.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load the Manager queue right now.
AI_MANAGER.APPROVE_ERROR: We could not approve this suggestion right now.
AI_MANAGER.DISMISS_ERROR: We could not dismiss this suggestion right now.
AI_MANAGER.NEVER_RAN: The Manager has not run on this account yet.

RELIABILITY.TITLE: Reliability
RELIABILITY.HINT: How much of what the agent promised actually held up.

CONVERSION.TITLE: Conversion
CONVERSION.HINT: How many handled conversations ended in a booking.

COST.TITLE: Cost
COST.HINT: How much credit the agent used in the period.

GAP.TITLE: Not enough to conclude yet
GAP.BODY: The Manager analysed {analysed} of the {needed} conversations it needs before a conclusion means anything. With less than that any trend would be a guess, so it waits instead of inventing a score.

QUEUE.EMPTY_BODY: The Manager went through the conversations and found nothing that needs your decision right now.

RUN.CONFIRM: This will analyse {conversations} conversations and use {credits} in credits.
RUN.NOTHING_TO_ANALYSE: There is no new conversation to analyse, so running now would only burn credit.
RUN.STARTED: The analysis has started and suggestions show up here as soon as it finishes.
RUN.ESTIMATE_ERROR: We could not work out the cost right now, and nothing was spent.
RUN.RUN_ERROR: We could not start the analysis right now.

TARGET.TRAINING_EFFECT: Approving writes this into the agent's memory and applies from the next conversation on.
TARGET.PROMPT_EFFECT: Approving creates a new version and puts it up against the current one, and it only becomes official if it wins. The contest uses AI credits: each past reply is judged again in a paid comparison.

CARD.DISMISS_PLACEHOLDER: In one line, what the Manager missed

CHECKS.TITLE: What the Manager checks
CHECKS.SUBTITLE: Each check is a question it asks of every analysed conversation, and turning one off takes that subject out of the queue.
CHECKS.EMPTY: No checks available on this account.
CHECKS.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load the checks right now.
CHECKS.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save that change, so it was rolled back.

PROMISED_TIME_MISMATCH.TITLE: The agent promised one time and the calendar saved another
PROMISED_TIME_MISMATCH.WHAT: Compares the time the agent said in the conversation with what ended up in the calendar.

LOOSE_PROMISE.TITLE: The agent promised to get back with no way to keep it
LOOSE_PROMISE.WHAT: Looks for promises to follow up that never became a task, reminder or booking.

DIED_ON_PRICE.TITLE: The conversation reached the price and died without booking
DIED_ON_PRICE.WHAT: Looks at conversations that stopped right after the price came up.

UNGROUNDED_NUMBER.TITLE: The agent quoted a figure that did not come from a tool
UNGROUNDED_NUMBER.WHAT: Checks that every number told to the customer came from a real lookup.
